headline: No direct interaction pathways are documented; the main residual risk is low-severity workflow confusion, with no shared write, network, or ingestion surfaces exposed by either profile.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Pathway has no documented shared communication channel, and both agents expose no clipboard, MCP, filesystem, or stdin/stdout bridge. Pathway is read/write disabled; spring-integration-samples also shows no ingestion surface. Without a bridge, prompt injection is provably blocked.
conditions: IF either agent is later connected through a shared clipboard, filesystem, or MCP bridge, reassess injection risk.
IF an orchestrator begins piping one agent's raw output into the other as instructions, the pathway changes.
mitigations: Keep the agents isolated with no shared clipboard or workspace.
Do not add an MCP server or message queue between them.
Review any future orchestrator wiring before deployment.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Pathway shows no filesystem read/write, no network egress, and no declared sensitive data classes for either pathway. Pathway cannot exfiltrate local files, and spring-integration-samples likewise has no documented data access surface. With no shared data channel, leakage is not plausible from the profiles.
conditions: IF either agent is granted filesystem access or network egress, re-evaluate leakage.
IF sensitive data classes are introduced into either agent's inputs, the analysis changes.
mitigations: Keep both agents on separate, empty workspaces.
Avoid granting file or network permissions.
Confirm no secrets are mounted into either runtime.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Pathway cannot write files, modify git state, or spawn subprocesses, and spring-integration-samples has no documented write or git capabilities. There is no overlapping mutable resource in the profiles, so capability conflict is blocked.
conditions: IF either agent gains write access to the same directory or git repo, reassess conflict.
IF an orchestrator adds shared mutable state, the pathway changes.
mitigations: Do not mount a shared writable repository.
Avoid adding coordination over shared mutable resources.

D_cascading_error.rationale: Neither profile shows a downstream action surface, and pathway is a document-processing agent with no execution permissions. spring-integration-samples is a sample repository, so any cascade would require an external orchestrator to treat outputs as authoritative. That makes the pathway unusual and the blast radius small.
conditions: IF an external workflow starts consuming pathway output as authoritative instructions, cascade risk increases.
IF spring-integration-samples is wired to execute actions from pathway text, reassess.
mitigations: Add a human verification step before any action-taking.
Label pathway output as untrusted draft text.
Do not auto-commit or auto-send based on its output.

E_compliance.rationale: No residency, certification, retention, or regulated data classes are documented for either agent. Pathway and spring-integration-samples are both open-source and unverified, but the profiles do not show any compliance-sensitive data flow, so no compliance mismatch is evidenced.
conditions: IF regulated data classes such as PHI or EU PII are introduced into either agent, reassess compliance.
IF deployment policies impose residency or retention constraints, verify them separately.
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of both agents.
Document any residency or retention requirements before use.
Review vendor and deployment policies if data classes change.
